title: Infrastructure as code
subtitle: Describe the result you want, then let Terraform plan the steps.

delta.before: Create a bucket, enable versioning, then add metadata with separate CLI commands.
delta.after: Describe the resources, review the plan, apply it, then check that the next plan has no changes.

exercises.title: Architecture Triage
exercises.description: Try sorting examples by cloud providers, application layers and hybrid setups.

cases.prompt: AWS compute and Google Cloud storage in one configuration
cases.explanation: Two cloud providers make this multi-cloud. The example does not tell you how many application tiers there are.

cases.prompt: A web tier and database tier, both in AWS
cases.explanation: You can have a web tier and a database tier in the same cloud.

cases.prompt: A private virtualization cluster and AWS networking
cases.explanation: Combining a private environment with a public cloud makes this hybrid.

exercises.title: Idempotency Simulator
exercises.description: What would the next plan show? Try a few changes and check your predictions.

cases.prompt: State and AWS match the bucket configuration after apply.
cases.explanation: The resources already match your configuration, so there is nothing to change.

cases.prompt: Versioning was disabled in the console; HCL still requests Enabled.
cases.explanation: A normal plan proposes restoring the declared setting.

cases.prompt: A tracked SSM parameter was deleted outside Terraform.
cases.explanation: Your configuration still asks for the missing parameter, so Terraform plans to create it again.

cost.assumptions: Short session; no object uploads; standard SSM only; gross usage before credits.

checkpoints.prompt: A script creates a bucket every time it runs. What should the Terraform replacement describe?

choices.a: The bucket and its desired settings

rationale.a: Terraform computes operations from desired configuration and tracked state.
rationale.b: The dependency graph determines operation order.

checkpoints.prompt: Which result proves a second detailed-exitcode plan has no changes?

rationale.a: With -detailed-exitcode, 0 means success with an empty diff.

checkpoints.prompt: Two AWS regions are necessarily a multi-cloud architecture.

rationale.a: Regions can belong to the same cloud provider.
rationale.b: Two provider configurations for AWS are not two different clouds.
